context.title: Invoice CSV export, ready to try
context.why: Invoices can be exported as a CSV file from the invoice list, filtered by period.

facts.label: Environment
facts.text: Staging, with three test invoices created for this page.

facts.label: Not shown
facts.text: C3: the export of more than 10,000 invoices needs a data set staging does not have.

examples.when: Export CSV is pressed for October 2026
examples.then: A CSV with three lines downloads

examples.when: Export CSV is pressed for January 2020
examples.then: No file downloads and a message says there is nothing to export

cases.title: Export the invoices of a month
cases.expected: A file `invoices-2026-10.csv` downloads, one line per invoice of October.

figures.caption: The Export CSV button beside the period filter
The downloaded file opened in a spreadsheet: three lines

tech.how: A new `GET /invoices/export?from&to` streams the CSV; the button builds the URL from the filter.
tech.data: Three invoices dated 3, 12 and 28 October 2026, created by the seed script.

cases.title: Export an empty period
cases.expected: No file downloads; a message says there is no invoice to export for this period.

figures.caption: The filter and the Export CSV button, before the click

tech.how: The endpoint answers 204 on an empty period; the button shows the message instead of downloading.

cases.title: Export more than 10,000 invoices
steps: Pick a period holding more than 10,000 invoices
cases.expected: The file downloads without the page freezing.
cases.unshown: Staging holds 3 invoices; a data set this large exists only in production.
